body: An open-source text-to-speech system that can synthesize speech and clone voices from reference audio.
plain_description: **Create expressive, natural sounding speech from text for your business.** Clone voices from short audio samples and produce multilingual, multi-speaker dialogue. Edit generated speech and guide its emotion with natural-language instructions.
technical_description: Fish Speech is an open-source text-to-speech system offering the Drama 3 and S2-Pro voice models. It supports multilingual voice cloning, multi-speaker generation, natural-language control of emotion and prosody, and an API server and WebUI. Drama 3 adds long-form dialogue, local audio editing, and multi-turn revision. The README links installation and inference guides for command-line, API-server, WebUI, and Docker setup.
title: Fish Speech
